arguments.command:
python3 -c "
import glob
for f in sorted(glob.glob('pptx_work/ppt/slides/_rels/*.rels')):
    print('==', f)
    print(open(f).read())
"

python3 - <<'EOF'
p = 'pptx_work/[Content_Types].xml'
s = open(p).read()
needle = '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
add = needle + '\n  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
if '/ppt/slides/slide6.xml' not in s:
    assert needle in s
    s = s.replace(needle, add)
    open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('done')
EOF

cp pptx_work/'[Content_Types].xml' /tmp/ct_backup.xml && echo "backup ok" && sed -i 's#<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>#<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>\n  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>#' pptx_work/'[Content_Types].xml' && grep -c slide6 pptx_work/'[Content_Types].xml'

sed -i 's#<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>#<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>\n    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>#' pptx_work/ppt/presentation.xml && grep -c 'id="261"' pptx_work/ppt/presentation.xml && grep -o 'rId1[0-9]' pptx_work/ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels | sort -u

arguments.command:
python3 - <<'EOF'
p = 'pptx_work/[Content_Types].xml'
s = open(p).read()
needle = '<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
add = needle + '\n  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>'
if '/ppt/slides/slide6.xml' not in s:
    assert needle in s
    s = s.replace(needle, add)
    open(p, 'w').write(s)
print('done')
EOF

cp pptx_work/'[Content_Types].xml' /tmp/ct_backup.xml && echo "backup ok" && sed -i 's#<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>#<Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide5.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>\n  <Override PartName="/ppt/slides/slide6.xml" ContentType="application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.presentationml.slide+xml"/>#' pptx_work/'[Content_Types].xml' && grep -c slide6 pptx_work/'[Content_Types].xml'

sed -i 's#<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>#<p:sldId id="260" r:id="rId12"/>\n    <p:sldId id="261" r:id="rId13"/>#' pptx_work/ppt/presentation.xml && grep -c 'id="261"' pptx_work/ppt/presentation.xml && grep -o 'rId1[0-9]' pptx_work/ppt/_rels/presentation.xml.rels | sort -u
